criteria.lastWordEnd: Final physically supported lexical voiced body or final consonant; later passive reverberation is excluded. Selected integers are time representations, not one-sample acoustic accuracy claims.
criteria.ownership: Estimated HTDemucs vocals include the sum of lead/backing vocals and separator leakage. Chorus aggregate voice release is a separate observation; no aggregate end is automatically assigned to the lead.
criteria.uncertainty: Ranges are independently visually reviewed plausibility brackets, not model confidence intervals. No release was copied from another chorus or clamped to an old crop or next onset.
criteria.modelLimits: Historical MMS and target-only English CTC timestamps are sparse transcript-conditioned encoder observations, not word-body ends. Scores are checkpoint-dependent and uncalibrated for singing, overlap, and tails. Context-aware model evidence was used only to anchor bridge call ownership; signal release was reviewed separately.
criteria.panelResolution: Primary panels use1024-sample Hann windows (23.22ms support), with view-dependent pixel time steps. The additional chains diagnostic used4096 samples (92.88ms) and did not resolve ownership.

limitations: Signal inspection is not human listening.
No single model core, first-energy threshold, or strongest vowel determines all performed boundaries.
Repeated backing occurrences were independently inferred; no acoustic-identity transfer was established or used.
Lead and backing ownership can overlap; an estimated-vocal tone cannot be assigned to the lead solely because it continues.
Exact integer samples store proposed points; the retained ownership ranges describe real uncertainty.
Complete normal-speed lyric/audio review is still required before promoting these proposals to synchronization acceptance.
